steps.name: Mors tua, vita mea (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Bel▒d] in 「▒Bo▒」and go to [Sha▒nik] in 「Ta▒Ta▒s」. Then, after defeating [Mal▒s] in “▒ of me▒,” report the quest to [▒i▒].

lines.text: (Belede is seen running to catch a tent flying away with the ground filled with red in the field of view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beled… ? Uh, this is Phobos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think I was definitely meeting someone in Esnil...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Remember what happened in Orcarium. El-Larsa disappeared, and Harmonia and Geass took Iris with them….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (And I went back to Esnil with Narsha, why am I here?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no way… . Probably not. Probably not.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to go to Beled... .
(Beled is lying down at the entrance of the tent with only his face exposed, with a tired expression.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Haha, it flew away again.
(When Beled meets %s's eyes, he steps back in surprise.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Well, what is it? You were surprised.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, I see... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: If you came because you wanted to hear stories about beauty, you are welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… , that's not it.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Now that I think about it, you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I don't think you are the one I know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It's hard to explain in words. You have one soul, but it seems like there is another one. Oh, I don't know what I'm talking about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I’m not sure, but I’m in a different time and space… Is that something like that?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, Beled. Shouldn't it be in the village?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It's good there, but it's good here too. I'll have to keep an eye on the beautiful castle. Even though the wind blows and I often fly away... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Come to think of it, I didn't ask you why you came here. what's the matter?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure. Suddenly I came to my senses and found myself here… .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Can you tell me what happened?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He tells the story that he only remembers everything from what happened at the Orcarium to meeting someone in Esnil.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: That's what happened to the goddess. Still, I think it will be okay since the spirits took me... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Since you are a person directly connected to the Goddess, you must have been influenced in some way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Ah, maybe… .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I will help you. Instead, you have to pick it up… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What item?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It must be the item that created this situation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn’t this situation like this because Iris got hurt?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'll tell you when I get the item. And you must not go to a place called Esnil until you come back to me. Because I don’t know what will happen or how… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it very dangerous?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It's because I'm a little anxious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then where do I find it?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: A place where the power of demons remains strong. The place I was thinking of was the room in Hell and Rosengarten... . Do you want to go to Hell’s room first?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Don't worry Rosengarten. I'll be preparing to open the other side of Rosengarten. If you find an item in the hell room, just close it again.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: If I had a power similar to Asmodea, I might be able to implement it surprisingly. Although it won't be a long time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay? It could be dangerous.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'll be fine.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: By the way, before going to the Hell Room, go to the owner there first. You will need permission to enter.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To Shinik? Is there something going on in Hell’s room…? .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Baldrick said he wanted to kill the demons that had flocked to the Hell Room, so I went in, and it must have been fun for the first time in a while.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: The owner of Tartarus came running here... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: The hell's room was all destroyed because of the idiot Gomtaeng!! It's so annoying, why did you make it so annoying to have to repair it!! Then I got angry and left.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I was definitely scared because I knew he wasn't an ordinary person... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A person who hates troublesome things must be doing troublesome things... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm in big trouble... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Why is that?
(Beled looks like he has no idea.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go first. ha… . If you go there, there must be some way.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Okay, please.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's annoying.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's not a fun job, but it's a lot of hassle♡
(An unknown darkness gathers around the smiling face of Shinik.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's just as I thought... .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Adventurer, are you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Melvik.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: However, it seems like the ground is shaking... .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: You can think of it as the feeling of Shinik, who is repairing the room in Hell.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Found a fun-looking face!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Shinik.
(As soon as Shinik recognizes Adventurer, the shaking of the entire Tartarus disappears.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What brought you here? Is this fun? huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came because I had to enter the Hell's room. That's what happens... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It is briefly told from what happened in the Orcarium to how suddenly it came to Phobos.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Is this Perse's dream?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Perse? A dream?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ah, I don’t think so… . If it's Perse's dream, there's no way I wouldn't recognize it... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If that's the case... . Phew… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Okay, go in♡

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: %s, Shinik is going to hell! No, it's a thorn in the abyss!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, yes. Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, by the way, I think Shinick’s expression has changed slightly...)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Instead, you go away and come back to me. Okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will, Shinik.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What are you doing? Not going? Go now. If I don’t go, I might die♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Ah, yes. I'll be there right away.
(When Melvik returns from seeing off Adventurer, Shinik is lying on the floor.)

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Shinik, you died of boredom in the meantime.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You didn't say anything to %s, did you?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Of course.
(Shaynick stands up with his eyes flashing.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I recreated Malpas and put it in, and I'm glad I was able to test it out.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: As expected, Shinik, you are amazing!

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehe, it'll be fun, right?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: %s I don't know what you think.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Was it fun? Was it fun?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… . It was fun.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If you had a good trip... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Do you think it would be okay to increase the difficulty level of Hell's Room? Someday, I will put you in the proper abyss♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I’m scared just hearing it….)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: By the way, was there something you were looking for?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, there wasn't.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If something had come out, I would have found it first. The only thing that came out was a box of meat bones that Baldrick ate and threw away.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I ran to Phobos and asked him, and he said he forgot to bring the box with the bones.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Baldrick, you are here.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I quit because I thought it would be more troublesome to deal with that idiot Gomtaeng.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If I couldn't find it here, I guess I'll have to look further for where the demons were? Rosengarten... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'd like to go with you, but I think you'll probably have to find the item yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be helped. Thank you at least for your words.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Sniff.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It smells like a witch, but it's not a witch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I don't know that either.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Even if I live a long time, I cannot know everything about the world.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm sorry I couldn't help you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Then I will go to Beled. good bye.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It was nice to see you after a long time. Then come visit again next time.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: See you next time, %s.

steps.name: Mors tua, vita mea (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [▒Sumo▒▒] in “Ro▒Ga▒Ten” and obtain <Black Moon Pendant>. Then report the quest to [▒Le▒].

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: How was the room in Hell?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When I said I had a good time, Shinik said he would try to make the hell room more difficult.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: He is no less evil than the devil. You didn't bring anything with you, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't find anything.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Then this time it's Rosengarten. While you were in the Hell Room, I created the other side of Rosengarten.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it okay to make a flip side?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yes, I rested a bit and it's okay. To this extent... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will come right away.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It's not a big deal, but it's something that bothers me. If you go behind the scenes to find traces of the demon world... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Beings that were not visible can react. A demon or a witch... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So maybe the reason I came here and met Beled was... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: A different type of mischief from a witch. It's like I'm asking you to find me

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I wanted to know that, so I asked %s to retrieve the item. Because if it's a demon item, I can recognize it.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'd like to go with you, but it might get weird if I go there, so I'll just rest here for a bit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Be careful… .
(After wandering around Rosengarten for a while, I find a black object on the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this? pendant?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Black crescent moon... , something that doesn't go well with the red rose garden.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like someone deliberately left it there for me to take...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, then I have no choice but to take it.
(Beled receives the Black Moon Pendant from %s and watches it closely.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It looks like it's broken, but it's still holding its shape... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you think you know something?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: As you said, I think it was placed there on purpose for you to take away. If you want to return to your original place, you have to destroy this thing without a trace.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It would be nice if it ended here... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Just give it a try.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where… .
(It's a black moon pendant that looks like it might break at any moment, but it doesn't break with the power of %s.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'll try it. In my hands, the minds of most weak beings will collapse... .
(Beled extends his hand toward the captured lesser demon. Then, the lesser demon curses Beled and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...It is said that Beled's power is the same as Asmodea's, so is this easy?...)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Then where… .
(Beled reaches for the Black Moon Pendant, but it does not break.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Neither my power as a demon nor your power as a god responds.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That means… … .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Another power is power, but it is not common. For example… .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: A god with more power than the goddess... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It has the power to easily ignore time and space... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: The reason I said you looked like a different person may have happened because I fell here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how did Beled recognize me like that?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I, Asmodea, meet the magic stone created by Weiss, and my eyes are opened by the witch's touch... . Because it’s different from a normal existence.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: … We need to destroy this.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Otherwise, you will continue to stay between different times and spaces. I may never meet the goddess again... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: If you don't destroy it and go back to Esnir where you were meeting someone... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: What the owner of this black moon pendant wants will happen.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I think this is Asmodea's knowledge. I knew he was wise since he was a devil who had lived with dream demons in the demon world for a long time, but... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Even if this matter is resolved, there is no way that the person who did this will not do the same thing again... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Still, it would be better to get out of this situation first.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: But the strange thing is. The power of the pendant's owner rests only on you. Shouldn't it be true that neither the owner of Tartarus nor I recognize you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see… . I'm not sure. Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: There must be a way if we find out something related to time and space... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, time and space… . perhaps… .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Can you think of a good way?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are many places where spirits influence time, space, and emotions.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Then go there. What can be done? Now, take this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Beled. I will find a way and come back.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: If we find a way, neither you nor I will remember this situation anyway. It's like something that was covered has disappeared.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: You will hear about beauty later. Okay?
(The figure of %s leaving, waving his hand, comes into Beled's field of vision.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: What, it's already gone.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Is beauty not important to ordinary humans?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: … But what are you?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I forgot to close the other side of Rosengarten, but it came out... .
Who?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: You, you. I'm not here to talk seriously about beauty.
The doll is pretty, beautiful.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Who are you?
Hello☆ I’m Circe.

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: I came to see the doll at my sister's request.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Witch… .

steps.name: Mors tua, vita mea (5)
steps.objective: Defeat [Kai▒▒] in 「▒▒Time of Los」 and obtain <Broken Spirit Wings>. Then, report the quest to [▒Luke] in 「P▒Ma」.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello. Arche.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I didn't even know you came here because you were thinking about something for a while. Welcome, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You came here under the influence of another time and space. It doesn't have much of an effect on the spirits of Pneuma, but just in case... .
(Arke sprays the Actinidia fragrant perfume she used before.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: This will be fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry, Arche. The reason I came like this... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Something must have happened to %s. are you okay. You need my help, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a bit long, but I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Arche everything from what happened in the Orcarium to how I came to Pneuma.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: El-Larsa… That's how the spirit ended his life. I've never met him, but... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: At one point, the spirits in Pneuma were looking at one place, and then a small light passed by Pneuma.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Maybe it was the light of El-Larsa.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Iris probably saved %s in order to make a choice he wouldn't regret. So don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, are the spirits of Pneuma okay?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I think it's okay. Since I'm not a spirit, I can't properly understand the thoughts and emotions of spirits, but I'm sure everyone was lonely... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Stop talking about this and go to Kairos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kairos?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Perhaps, Kairos feels something uncomfortable as someone intervenes in a special moment of Adventurer's time, which is connected to Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does Arche know about it?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I don't know. The only gods I know are Gaia and Iris. Those who are connected to Pneuma... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Kairos and Kronos may know a lot because they have lived longer than me, but since they are spirits, they cannot escape providence.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Providence… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You can think of Iris and El-Larsa that Adventurer saw in Orcarium.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The more I listen to the story, the more complicated it becomes. Did the old man send someone else to this world?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, I will go to Kairos.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes, please come back. %s.
(Kairos must have been surprised, but his hair stood up a lot, but after checking the appearance of %s, it returned to normal.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: You were surprised. I barely fell asleep, but then he showed up... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you wake me up from my sleep?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: It's okay. But what happened... .  Sniff... . I smelled perfume, so I went to Arche.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: And it was influenced by other forces… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here's how it happened... .

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: It's okay. There's no need to explain it.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Goddess is fine now, so you don’t have to worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And… .

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I can't talk about that. sorry. Because I am a spirit... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Take this to Arche.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: These are the wings of a spirit that flew from the land of Orca. It's a lot broken.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is this here?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: As that power intervened in what happened in Orca's land, it could not hold on and flew into my territory.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Since it is an object that remembers part of your time, it might lead you to the time you will return to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But is pneuma really okay?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: It's okay. Just a little bit affected. It won't collapse here. If this place collapses, the whole world will be in danger, so even the twisted ones will leave this place alone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Ah, I can get some sleep now. I couldn't get this thing out of here without you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, okay. Kairos, thank you.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Then, be careful.
(As soon as Kairos finishes speaking, he lies down and falls asleep.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: ZzzZzz….

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you already asleep?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel sleepy too. Haam… . This is not the time to be like this. Let's go quickly.

steps.name: Mors tua, vita mea (6)
steps.objective: Obtain <Fragment of Enteleche> from 「▒Tel▒ke of ▒name」 and <Source of Light> from 「Geo▒ground of Jeong▒」. Then report the quest to [▒▒Ke] in 「▒New▒」.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Did you enjoy meeting Kairos?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Kairos is sleeping comfortably after giving him this. Arche, do you know what this is?
(Arke receives the spirit wings from %s.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: These are spirit wings. I think it fell from a spirit that lost the light of life.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kairos said it came to Pneuma with a memory of part of its time.  And he tells me to give this to Arche.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Are you giving this to me? Hmm… .
(Arke takes the spirit wings and looks like he has no idea.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Looking at the expression on Arke’s face, I don’t think it’s a secret… huh?)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The pendant is cracking.
(A slight cracking sound can be heard from the black moon pendant in %s's hand. However, it is only slightly cracked and not completely destroyed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think the black moon pendant became like this because of the spirit wings... . Why stop here?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: This is because the power of the black moon is stronger than the power radiating from the spirit wings.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It was thanks to Iris that the pendant was able to crack like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it Iris?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: These spirit wings were sent by Iris. To protect Adventurer... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: As long as Iris, the owner of the moon, flowers, and plants, is on this planet, there will always be a bright and beautiful moon... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Otherwise it will turn into a dreary black moon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute. There is only one Iris master of the moon, but are there more such beings?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Just as Gaia shared the vegetation on the earth with Ceres, the moon may not have been in the hands of Ceres alone from the beginning.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know the circumstances of the ancient gods, but that doesn't mean... . Ah, it’s complicated… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Actually, it's a bit complicated for me too. I can barely organize what the spirits are saying... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Once the entity is revealed, its name will be recognized, but not yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: With Iris's help, I was only able to destroy half of it, but what should I do with the other half... . It takes that much strength... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: These spirit wings came from Orcarium, so shall we look there one more time?
(When Arke hears %s's words, he opens his arms to the surroundings. Then, spirits come from somewhere and whisper to Arke in an unknown voice.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The spirits say this is a good method.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Adventurer is now in a different time and space after returning from the Orcarium... , One way or another, the location of the Orcarium will remain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There might be something waiting for me to arrive, like the Black Moon Pendant... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: If you find that item, come back here. Pneuma is a safer place than any other place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, Arche. Instead of going somewhere else, I will come straight to Pneuma. See you later then.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Be careful… .
(While wandering through the Enteleche of Life, I see a small piece of stone shining with a peculiar feeling.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The fragment of Enteleche discovered by Narsha... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It definitely disappeared then... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's take it for now.

(Behind the place where I met El-Larsa, I can see the trees that the spirit once loved. A small orb of light can be seen between the stumps that have been cut down and contain growth rings from many years ago.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is the light that was hovering around El-Larsa... , I feel a strong power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This will do, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let’s take it to the pneuma… .

steps.name: Mors tua, vita mea (7)
steps.objective: After everything is over, return to the last location of the main scenario “Orcarium” and report the quest to [Nar▒].

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s, are you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When I went there as Arche said, I was able to find an object with strong power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: However, it feels different from when I went with Narsha.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: That’s a different time and space… . Maybe it's the other side.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, Arche.

(The Black Moon Pendant, the source of light, and the fragments of Enteleche all gather in Arche's hand. The source of light and the fragments of Enteleche turn into bright light and begin to surround the black moon pendant.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I can feel the pure power of the spirit. The energy of light that stayed in the Orcarium, including El-Larsa... .
(The light grows bigger and enters the cracked black moon pendant. After a while, the black moon pendant shakes and turns into powder little by little.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it all over?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Not yet. These powders shouldn't be here.
(As Arche stretches out her hand toward the sky, the powder that turns into shining sand flows somewhere with the wind.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Now Adventurer can go back to its original time zone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, but how does it work?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Close your eyes, Adventurer. The spirits will guide you back to your original time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Arche. But it doesn't fall from the sky or anything, does it?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Hehe, no.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Adventurer will now return to its original space and time. Memories affected by the black moon disappear.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's normal for Adventurer not to remember the people he met, but people like Beled and Shinik... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We leave them out because they are not ordinary beings.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Hehe, that's right.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The moment you come face to face with your original memories, you may feel dizzy for a moment... . Because I was like that too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was it like that then?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yeah, it's a little similar.  I'm telling you this just in case you don't know.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Now, close your eyes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arke, see you later.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What if….)
(Warm cotton? Clouds? Was it Aerura? It’s so fluffy that I think I’ll fall asleep like this….)
(When I raise my head, a woman with blue eyes shining like jewels is smiling kindly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is this drowsy feeling...? Where have I been for a while?...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But who is that person? She is as beautiful as a halo... She is wearing a sun-shaped tiara...)

lines.speaker: 여성
lines.text: Hello, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello… . By the way, do you know me?

lines.speaker: 여성
lines.text: Of course.
(The woman suddenly grabs %s's hands.)

lines.speaker: 여성
lines.text: I wanted to meet you, but I haven't had the chance. %s was busy too, as was I.

lines.speaker: 여성
lines.text: Let me say hello.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: What is this because of my stupid sister... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I am Kaina Dawn Sylvaria... , who is Dana’s older sister. Thank you for being a great help to my younger siblings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nice to meet you too. But, if it’s Dana’s older sister… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, uh, huh?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, Emperor of the Sylvaria Empire?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Uh, wait a minute... I feel like déjà vu... Have I ever met His Majesty? That's not true...)
(Kaina's smiling expression quickly changes into a different feeling.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … your majesty?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's nothing... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: If you stay blank like that, you might fall into the void, hehe.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: About the new witch that will appear soon... .
